proposed_capability: P95: factor scene-backed Live(F1)/Buy(F2)/Build(F3) mode context into existing listener and asynchronous microsystems, with bounded menu/context hints; P124: keep scene catalog authoritative and reuse existing Build floor census and tandem coordinator, not a duplicate listener or daemon. player_save_control_impact: Read-only classification with per-tick freshness. Explicit mode ambiguity or non-Live scene prevents new autonomy dispatch; player-directed and unknown presence always yield. No SendInput, no save touches, no background worker.

rollback_path: Revert the feature PR; existing listener/scene ownership and BI-002 remain active.
